{{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{use mdy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox television season | bgcolor = #78473F | image = dwts9poster.jpg | caption = Promotional poster for Season 9 | module1 = {{Infobox reality competition season | host = {{Plainlist| * [[Tom Bergeron]] * [[Samantha Harris]] }} | judges = {{Plainlist| * [[Carrie Ann Inaba]] * [[Len Goodman]] * [[Bruno Tonioli]] }} | celebrity_winner = [[Donny Osmond]] | professional_winner = [[Kym Johnson]] }} | num_episodes = 21 | network = [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] | first_aired = {{start date|2009|9|21}} | last_aired = {{end date|2009|11|24}} }} '''Season nine''' of ''[[Dancing with the Stars (American TV series)|Dancing with the Stars]]'' premiered on September 21, 2009, on the [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] network. Some changes were added this season, including a larger cast and relay dances. Four new dances were introduced to complement the large cast: the [[bolero]], [[Lambada (dance)|lambada]], [[Country-western two-step|two-step]], and [[Charleston (dance)|Charleston]]. Singer [[Donny Osmond]] and [[Kym Johnson]] were crowned the winners, while singer [[Mýa]] and [[Dmitry Chaplin]] finished in second place, and reality star [[Kelly Osbourne]] and [[Louis Van Amstel|Louis van Amstel]] finished in third place. ==Cast== ===Couples=== This season featured sixteen celebrity contestants. The cast was unveiled on the August 17, 2009, edition of ''[[Good Morning America]]''. Executive producer [[Conrad Green]] confirmed to ''[[Entertainment Tonight]]'' that the season would feature three double-eliminations throughout the season.ET Confirms New Twist for 'Dancing With The Stars' http://tv.msn.com/tv/article.aspx?news=425346>1=28103 {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090813070831/http://tv.msn.com/tv/article.aspx?news=425346>1=28103 |date=2009-08-13 }} Former [[Party leaders of the United States House of Representatives|U.S. House Majority Leader]] [[Tom DeLay]] withdrew from the competition in week three; however, [[Debi Mazar]] was also eliminated on the same night, replacing the double elimination planned for week five. scope="row" | Ashley & Edyta |16th | bgcolor="f4c7b8" {{sort|19|}} | 15+4={{fontcolor|#800000|''19''}}{{double-dagger|alt=This was the lowest score of the night.}}{{efn|name=Elim|This couple was eliminated.}} |} ;Notes {{notelist}} ==Weekly scores== ''Individual judges scores in charts below (given in parentheses) are listed in this order from left to right: [[Carrie Ann Inaba]], [[Len Goodman]], [[Bruno Tonioli]].'' ===Week 1=== The couples had to prepare two dances (either the [[Cha-cha-cha (dance)|cha-cha-cha]] or [[foxtrot]], and the [[Salsa (dance)|salsa]] or [[Viennese waltz]]) dividing themselves between men and women. The men performed on the first night and the women on the second night. On the first night, the men performed either the cha-cha-cha or foxtrot, and then participated in either a salsa or Viennese waltz relay. The judges ranked the couples in each relay. On the second night, the women performed either the salsa or Viennese waltz, and then participated in either a cha-cha-cha or foxtrot relay. One couple was eliminated at the end of each night. Couples are listed in the order they performed. [[Tom DeLay]] was reported as having a possible stress fracture in his foot on September 15, just one week before the competition.{{cite web |date=2009-09-15 |title=Tom DeLay Injured While Rehearsing for Dancing with the Stars |url=https://people.com/tv/tom-delay-injured-while-rehearsing-for-dancing-with-the-stars/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090924105217/http://tvwatch.people.com/2009/09/15/tom-delay-injured-while-rehearsing-for-dancing-with-the-stars/ |archive-date=2009-09-24 |access-date=2020-02-28 |work=People}} However, the injury did not keep him out of the competition. Additionally, [[Mýa]] had to go to the hospital for stitches on September 20 after a glass shattered in her hand. This injury did not affect her performance.{{cite web |date=2009-09-21 |title=Mya Injures Hand Before Dancing with the Stars Premiere |url=https://people.com/tv/mya-injures-hand-before-dancing-with-the-stars-premiere/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090926114431/http://tvwatch.people.com/2009/09/21/mya-injures-hand-before-dancing-with-the-stars-premiere/ |archive-date=2009-09-26 |access-date=2020-02-28 |work=People}} After the show, [[Debi Mazar]] was taken to the hospital with a torn muscle in her neck and chest.{{cite web |author= |date=September 23, 2009 |title=Debi Mazar Goes to Hospital After 'Dancing with the Stars' Performance |url=https://oklahoman.com/article/feed/83133/debi-mazar-goes-to-hospital-after-dancing-with-the-stars-performance |access-date=February 28, 2020 |publisher=The Oklahoman |archive-date=February 29, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200229042607/https://oklahoman.com/article/feed/83133/debi-mazar-goes-to-hospital-after-dancing-with-the-stars-performance |url-status=dead }} ;Night 1 (Men) {| class="wikitable sortable" style="text-align:center; width:90%" |- !
